items.name: metro-theme
items.title: Metro theme
items.description: The metro fleet theme: the dark palette plus tokyonight, catppuccin, kanagawa, nord, dracula and gruvbox, the shadcn token mapping, the base layer and the shared component classes.

items.name: theme-store
items.title: Theme store
items.description: The fleet theme store: one preference under one key, applied as data-theme on <html>, dark by default. Framework-agnostic, no dependencies.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.title: Theme switcher
items.description: The fleet theme picker (a small menu, not a shadcn dropdown), identical in every service.

items.name: version-badge
items.title: Version badge
items.description: The application version and release channel, set next to the wordmark.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: The `cn` class-name helper shared by every component.

items.name: mentions
items.title: Mentions
items.description: The `@ФамилияИО` splitter: it matches the backend's mention key so a mention is highlighted exactly where the backend links it.

items.name: numeric-input
items.title: Numeric input helpers
items.description: The sanitiser behind NumberInput: digits only, no browser number semantics.

items.name: floating-autocomplete-menu
items.title: Floating autocomplete menu
items.description: The shared dropdown surface: fixed-position, portalled into the dialog when the field lives in one, opens downwards.

items.name: icon-action-button
items.title: Icon action button
items.description: The compact icon-only action button used on rows and cards.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The fleet button.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: The fleet badge.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The fleet card.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The fleet switch (boolean settings; checkboxes stay for list selection).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The dialog primitive. Clicking the backdrop does not close it — only an explicit button or Escape does.

items.name: app-dialog
items.title: App dialog
items.description: The app's own shell over the dialog: title, body, footer and the dismissal contract.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The fleet's single-choice list — never a native <select> (that opens an OS popup).

items.name: searchable-select
items.title: Searchable select
items.description: Single/multi select with chips, keyboard navigation, a results cap and optional query history.

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date input
items.description: The date field and its calendar (react-day-picker, Russian locale). No native date input and no separate «today» button.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: The numeric field: a text input with inputMode=numeric and a digits-only filter, not type=number.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File input
items.description: The fleet file field: a paperclip button and the chosen file's name, instead of the browser's own control.

items.name: time-input
items.title: Time input
items.description: The fleet time field: a masked text input, so the browser never opens the operating system's clock picker.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: The fleet password field with a show/hide control (the app's own input, never a bare type=password).

items.name: mention-text
items.title: Mention text
items.description: Renders message and comment text with mentions highlighted by the theme token.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status badge
items.description: Tone-based status badge built on semantic theme tokens.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: The fleet empty state: icon, title, description and an optional action, the same in every list.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: The fleet progress bar: a track and a fill on the theme's accent, with an optional label and value.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: Metric card for dashboards.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings section
items.description: The fleet settings section: a card whose header is a disclosure control.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: The fleet page header: title, description and the page's actions (the header the fleet's pages use).

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The fleet application shell: collapsible sidebar, mobile drawer, top bar with the brand, the version badge, the status slot and the actions slot. Everything service-specific is a slot.

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account menu
items.description: The fleet account block of the top bar: theme picker, profile link and the account dialog with the identity and the exit.
